note: 人工策展的 CCUS 领域本体。与 PDF 抽取图谱分开维护：抽取给的是'这几篇论文提到了什么'，本体给的是'这个领域有哪些东西'。每条实体与关系都必须带 source，没有出处的条目不允许进本文件。合并进图谱由 scripts/augment_graph.py 完成，纯确定性、可重复执行、按名字去重。

entities.name: Deep Saline Aquifer
entities.description: 含咸水的深部多孔地层，是容量最大的 CO2 封存目标。
entities.reference: IPCC (2005) Special Report on CCS, Ch.5

entities.name: Depleted Gas Reservoir
entities.description: 已枯竭的气藏，压力与封闭性已被地质时间验证。

entities.name: Depleted Oil Reservoir
entities.description: 已枯竭的油藏，常与 CO2-EOR 结合。

entities.name: Basalt Formation
entities.description: 玄武岩储层，注入溶解 CO2 后快速矿化为碳酸盐。

entities.name: Coal Seam
entities.description: 煤层，CO2 吸附置换甲烷（ECBM），但吸附容量与渗透率高度不均。

entities.name: Organic-Rich Shale Reservoir
entities.description: 富有机质页岩，吸附容量大但基质渗透率极低。

entities.name: Carbonate Reservoir
entities.description: 碳酸盐岩储层，非均质性强，裂缝与溶孔控制流动。

entities.name: Sandstone Reservoir
entities.description: 砂岩储层，孔隙度与渗透率关系相对可预测，是最常见的封存目标。

entities.name: Tight Sandstone Reservoir
entities.description: 低渗致密砂岩，注入性受破裂压力与孔喉控制。

entities.name: Reef Carbonate Buildup
entities.description: 生物礁碳酸盐岩体，常具高孔高渗与陡峭侧翼。

entities.name: Fluvial-Deltaic Sandstone
entities.description: 河流-三角洲砂岩，砂体连通性受河道几何控制。

entities.name: Aeolian Sandstone
entities.description: 风成砂岩，粒度均一、横向连续性好。

entities.name: Turbidite Sandstone
entities.description: 浊积砂岩，砂泥互层导致垂向封闭性差异大。

entities.name: Mt. Simon Sandstone
entities.description: 美国伊利诺伊盆地寒武系砂岩，Decatur 工业规模封存项目的注入层。

entities.name: Utsira Formation
entities.description: 北海 Sleipner 的 Utsira 砂岩，全球最早的海上工业规模 CO2 封存注入层。

entities.name: Tubåen Formation
entities.description: Snøhvit 项目的注入层，因压力上升过快而后改为 Stø 组。

entities.name: Stø Formation
entities.description: Snøhvit 项目 2011 年后接替 Tubåen 的注入层。

entities.name: Johansen Formation
entities.description: 挪威北海候选封存单元，属侏罗系砂岩。
entities.reference: Norwegian Petroleum Directorate (2011) CO2 Storage Atlas, Norwegian North Sea

entities.name: Frio Formation
entities.description: 美国墨西哥湾岸 Frio 组，Frio Brine Pilot 的注入层。

entities.name: Latrobe Group
entities.description: 澳大利亚 Gippsland 盆地 Latrobe 群，Otway 项目的储层。

entities.name: Midale Beds
entities.description: 加拿大 Williston 盆地 Midale 层，Weyburn-Midale CO2-EOR 与封存项目的注入层。

entities.name: Bunter Sandstone
entities.description: 英国南部北海三叠系砂岩，被评估为大型封存单元。
entities.reference: British Geological Survey CO2 storage appraisal (Bentham et al. 2014)

entities.name: Rotliegend Sandstone
entities.description: 南二叠盆地最主要的储层，上覆 Zechstein 蒸发岩盖层。
entities.reference: Glennie (1997) Petroleum Geology of the North Sea

entities.name: Captain Sandstone
entities.description: 英国北海 Captain 砂岩，Goldeneye 封存项目目标层。
entities.reference: Shell/SSE Goldeneye CO2 storage project documentation

entities.name: Arbuckle Group
entities.description: 美国堪萨斯 Arbuckle 群咸水层，被大量用于液体处置，压力监测数据丰富。
entities.reference: Kansas Geological Survey Arbuckle brine disposal studies

entities.name: Storage Complex
entities.description: 法规意义上的封存复合体：储层 + 盖层 + 次生封闭单元。

entities.name: Residual Trapping
entities.description: CO2 被毛管力锁在孔隙中成为不连续残余相，随运移路径增长而增强。

entities.name: Solubility Trapping
entities.description: CO2 溶于地层水，溶解态密度略大于水，产生对流混合。

entities.name: Mineral Trapping
entities.description: CO2 与岩石反应生成碳酸盐矿物，时间尺度最长但最永久。

entities.name: Structural Trapping
entities.description: 背斜或断层封闭形成的构造圈闭阻止 CO2 继续上浮。

entities.name: Stratigraphic Trapping
entities.description: 岩性尖灭或相变形成的非构造圈闭。

entities.name: Capillary Trapping
entities.description: 毛管压力束缚 CO2 相，与残余捕集共同决定羽流停止运移的位置。

entities.name: CO2 Plume Migration
entities.description: 超临界 CO2 在浮力驱动下的运移路径，受储层非均质性与地形控制。

entities.name: Storage Capacity Estimate
entities.description: 封存容量估算，不同方法（CSLF/DOE/USGS）之间可差一个数量级。

entities.name: Normal Fault
entities.description: 正断层，最大主应力近垂直，注入引起的应力路径易促使其重新活化。

entities.name: Reverse Fault
entities.description: 逆断层，最大水平应力近垂直断层走向，抗滑安全系数对孔隙压力最敏感。

entities.name: Strike-Slip Fault
entities.description: 走滑断层，最大与最小水平应力均近水平。

entities.name: Thrust Fault
entities.description: 低角度逆冲断层，常构成侧向封闭。

entities.name: Oblique-Slip Fault
entities.description: 斜滑断层，兼具走向与倾滑分量。

entities.name: Listric Normal Fault
entities.description: 上陡下缓的铲状正断层，常伴生滚动背斜圈闭。

entities.name: Growth Fault
entities.description: 同沉积断层，两盘地层厚度差异显著。

entities.name: Fault Core
entities.description: 断层核部，粒度细化、常为渗流障壁。

entities.name: Fault Damage Zone
entities.description: 断层核外侧的裂缝密集带，通常提高渗透率。
entities.reference: Kim et al. (2004) J. Struct. Geol. 26

entities.name: Fault Gouge
entities.description: 断层泥，未固结细粒断层岩，含黏土时封闭性显著提高。

entities.name: Cataclasite
entities.description: 碎裂岩，固结的细粒断层岩。

entities.name: Fracture Process Zone
entities.description: 断层端部的破裂过程区，微裂缝密度向外递减。
entities.reference: Kim et al. (2004) J. Struct. Geol. 26

entities.name: Relay Ramp
entities.description: 两条断层叠覆段的连接带，常为渗流优势通道。
entities.reference: Walsh & Watterson (1991) Geol. Soc. Spec. Publ. 56

entities.name: Fault Zone Architecture
entities.description: 断层核 + 损伤带的分带结构，决定断层是通道还是障壁。

entities.name: Fault Permeability Structure
entities.description: 断层带渗透率的空间分布，沿走向与垂向均可差数个数量级。

entities.name: Fault Transmissibility Multiplier
entities.description: 油藏模拟中用于折算断层传导能力的乘子。

entities.name: Shale Smear
entities.description: 泥岩层被拖曳进断层面形成的连续泥质涂抹，降低跨断层渗漏。
entities.reference: Lindsay et al. (1993) Norw. Pet. Soc. Spec. Publ. 3

entities.name: Clay Smear
entities.description: 黏土质层沿断层面的涂抹，连续性决定封闭能力。

entities.name: Juxtaposition Seal
entities.description: 储层与非渗透层跨断层并置形成的封闭。

entities.name: Fault Seal Analysis
entities.description: 用 SGR（泥岩涂抹潜力）等指标定量评价断层封闭性。

entities.name: Slip Tendency
entities.description: 剪应力与有效正应力之比 Ts = τ/σ'n，超过摩擦系数即活化。

entities.name: Dilation Tendency
entities.description: 断层面上正应力与差应力的比值，指示张性开启倾向。

entities.name: Critically Stressed Fault
entities.description: 处于摩擦临界状态的断层，孔隙压力小幅上升即可触发滑动。

entities.name: Fault Slip Rate
entities.description: 断层滑动速率，与诱发地震震级和能量释放相关。
entities.reference: Scholz (2019) The Mechanics of Earthquakes and Faulting

entities.name: Fault Reactivation Pressure
entities.description: 使断层达到摩擦临界所需的孔隙压力，即本项目的 pp_crit。

entities.name: Fault Damage Zone Width
entities.description: 损伤带宽度，随断层位移量呈幂律增长。
entities.reference: Kim et al. (2004) J. Struct. Geol. 26

entities.name: Induced Seismicity Magnitude
entities.description: 注入诱发地震的震级，受断层面积与应力降控制。
entities.reference: Scholz (2019) The Mechanics of Earthquakes and Faulting

entities.name: Zechstein Halite
entities.description: 二叠系 Zechstein 盐岩，南二叠盆地的区域盖层，自封闭性极强。

entities.name: Zechstein Anhydrite
entities.description: Zechstein 硬石膏，盐岩序列顶底的致密层。

entities.name: Nordland Shale
entities.description: 北海 Sleipner 的 Utsira 砂岩之上盖层，4D 地震显示 CO2 未穿过。

entities.name: Kimmeridge Clay Formation
entities.description: 北海侏罗系主要烃源岩，同时是多个油气田的区域盖层。
entities.reference: British Geological Survey North Sea lithostratigraphy

entities.name: Opalinus Clay
entities.description: 瑞士侏罗系黏土岩，自封闭性（self-sealing）被 Mont Terri 地下实验室长期验证。

entities.name: Pierre Shale
entities.description: Williston 盆地白垩系页岩，Weyburn-Midale 项目的区域盖层。

entities.name: Eau Claire Formation
entities.description: 伊利诺伊盆地上覆 Mt. Simon 的区域盖层。

entities.name: Mercia Mudstone Group
entities.description: 英国三叠系泥石群，东爱尔兰海与陆上的区域盖层。
entities.reference: British Geological Survey CO2 storage appraisal

entities.name: Oxford Clay Formation
entities.description: 英国侏罗系厚层黏土岩，兼具源岩与盖层作用。
entities.reference: British Geological Survey onshore Jurassic stratigraphy

entities.name: Gault Clay Formation
entities.description: 英国下白垩统黏土岩，英国陆上封存评估中的关键盖层。
entities.reference: British Geological Survey CO2 storage appraisal

entities.name: Boom Clay
entities.description: 比利时中新统黏土，低渗透、强自封闭，被用于地下实验室研究。
entities.reference: Belgian Nuclear Research Centre (SCK CEN) Boom Clay studies, Mol

entities.name: Evaporite Caprock
entities.description: 蒸发岩盖层，渗透率近零且具塑性，裂缝可自愈。

entities.name: Halite Seal
entities.description: 盐岩封闭层，毛管进入压力极高，但遇淡水可溶解。

entities.name: Anhydrite Seal
entities.description: 硬石膏封闭层，脆性高于盐岩，易发育裂缝。

entities.name: Shale Caprock
entities.description: 页岩盖层，封闭性来自高毛管进入压力而非绝对不渗透。

entities.name: Mudstone Caprock
entities.description: 泥岩盖层，最常见的区域封闭岩性。

entities.name: Siltstone Caprock
entities.description: 粉砂岩盖层，孔喉较粗，封闭能力弱于泥岩。

entities.name: Marl Caprock
entities.description: 泥灰岩盖层，碳酸盐含量高，遇酸性流体反应性强。

entities.name: Regional Top Seal
entities.description: 覆盖整个盆地或次级盆地的区域性盖层。

entities.name: Lateral Seal
entities.description: 侧向封闭，可由相变、断层或地层尖灭提供。

entities.name: Capillary Seal
entities.description: 靠毛管进入压力阻止非润湿相 CO2 进入盖层孔隙。

entities.name: Capillary Entry Pressure
entities.description: CO2 突破盖层所需的毛管压力阈值，与孔喉半径成反比。

entities.name: Seal Bypass System
entities.description: 盖层被断层、裂缝、侵入体或管涌绕过的通道体系。

entities.name: Caprock Membrane Seal
entities.description: 盖层完整无裂缝时，靠毛管压力形成的薄膜式封闭。

entities.name: Caprock Hydraulic Seal
entities.description: 盖层渗透率极低且压力梯度不足以驱动流动时的封闭。

entities.name: Caprock Self-Sealing
entities.description: 裂缝或渗漏通道被矿物沉淀、黏土膨胀或盐岩蠕变重新封闭。

entities.name: Caprock Geomechanical Damage
entities.description: 注入引起应力与孔隙压力变化导致盖层产生新的破裂。

entities.name: Caprock Tensile Failure
entities.description: 孔隙压力超过最小主应力与抗拉强度之和时盖层被张裂。

entities.name: Caprock Shear Failure
entities.description: 盖层内部剪应力超过强度导致剪切破坏。

entities.name: Caprock Fracture Reopening
entities.description: 已有裂缝在孔隙压力上升后重新张开成为渗漏通道。

entities.name: Caprock Permeability
entities.description: 盖层渗透率，泥岩常在 1e-9 到 1e-7 D 量级，盐岩近零。

entities.name: Caprock Thickness
entities.description: 盖层厚度，决定毛管封闭的可靠性与抗破坏余量。

entities.name: Caprock Brittleness Index
entities.description: 脆性指数越高，盖层越容易产生贯通裂缝而非塑性变形。

entities.name: Caprock Clay Content
entities.description: 黏土含量，提高毛管进入压力并增强自封闭能力。

entities.name: Smectite Swelling
entities.description: 蒙脱石遇水膨胀，可封闭裂缝也可能造成井壁失稳。

entities.name: CO2-Brine-Rock Reaction in Caprock
entities.description: 酸性流体与盖层矿物反应，可能溶蚀提高渗透率或沉淀自封闭。

entities.name: Caprock Diffusion
entities.description: 溶解态 CO2 在盖层中的分子扩散，速率极慢但时间尺度长。

entities.name: Salt Weld
entities.description: 盐岩流动后残留的薄层焊接带，封闭性可能被削弱。

entities.name: Salt Diapir Seal
entities.description: 盐丘侧翼构成的侧向封闭，常见于墨西哥湾与北海。

entities.name: Caprock Column Height Capacity
entities.description: 盖层毛管进入压力所能支撑的最大 CO2 柱高，本项目 caprock.py 的 h_max。

entities.name: Surface Casing
entities.description: 表层套管，隔离浅层淡水。
entities.reference: API Standard 65-Part 2, Isolating Potential Flow Zones

entities.name: Intermediate Casing
entities.description: 技术套管，封隔不稳定地层与压力过渡带。

entities.name: Production Casing
entities.description: 生产套管，CO2 注入井中直接承受酸性环境。

entities.name: Casing Shoe
entities.description: 套管鞋，套管柱最下端，是水泥返高的关键控制点。

entities.name: Liner Hanger
entities.description: 尾管悬挂器，连接尾管与上层套管。

entities.name: Cement Plug
entities.description: 水泥塞，用于封堵井段或弃井。
entities.reference: Vrålstad et al. (2016) J. Pet. Sci. Eng. 147

entities.name: Wellhead
entities.description: 井口装置，承受注入压力并密封各层环空。

entities.name: Downhole Safety Valve
entities.description: 井下安全阀，失效时自动关闭防止失控流。

entities.name: Packer Element
entities.description: 封隔器胶筒，弹性体在 CO2 环境中易老化。

entities.name: Tubing String
entities.description: 油管柱，CO2 注入的主要流道。

entities.name: Perforation Interval
entities.description: 射孔段，决定注入流体进入储层的位置与流量分配。

entities.name: Well Integrity Failure
entities.description: 井在全生命周期内可靠封隔流体的能力。

entities.name: Sustained Casing Pressure
entities.description: 环空持续带压，是井屏障失效的直接指示。
entities.reference: API Recommended Practice 90, Annular Casing Pressure Management

entities.name: Annular Casing Pressure
entities.description: 套管环空压力，用于判断屏障是否泄漏。

entities.name: Legacy Well Integrity
entities.description: 历史老井的完整性风险，是封存场地最大的不确定性来源之一。
entities.reference: Zhang & Bachu (2011) Int. J. Greenh. Gas Control 5

entities.name: Well Abandonment
entities.description: 弃井作业，需保证长期（千年尺度）封隔。
entities.reference: Vrålstad et al. (2016) J. Pet. Sci. Eng. 147

entities.name: Plug and Abandonment
entities.description: P&A：下入水泥塞与桥塞永久封堵井筒。
entities.reference: Vrålstad et al. (2016) J. Pet. Sci. Eng. 147

entities.name: Cement Bond Log
entities.description: 声幅测井，评价水泥与套管/地层的胶结质量。

entities.name: Ultrasonic Casing Inspection
entities.description: 超声成像测井，检测套管壁厚与腐蚀。

entities.name: CO2-Resistant Cement
entities.description: 抗 CO2 腐蚀水泥体系，通过降低钙硅比抑制碳化。
entities.reference: Kutchko et al. (2008) Environ. Sci. Technol. 42

entities.name: Geopolymer Cement
entities.description: 地聚合物水泥，无钙体系，抗酸性流体侵蚀。
entities.reference: Duguid & Scherer (2010) Int. J. Greenh. Gas Control 4

entities.name: Cement Carbonation
entities.description: 水泥中 C-S-H 与 CO2 反应生成碳酸钙，先致密后溶蚀。
entities.reference: Kutchko et al. (2008) Environ. Sci. Technol. 42

entities.name: Casing Corrosion
entities.description: 套管在含 CO2/H2S 地层水中腐蚀减薄。
entities.reference: Carey et al. (2007) Int. J. Greenh. Gas Control 1

entities.name: Wellbore Leakage Pathway
entities.description: 沿井筒的泄漏通道：套管-水泥界面、水泥-地层界面或水泥本体。
entities.reference: Zhang & Bachu (2011) Int. J. Greenh. Gas Control 5

entities.name: Injection Well Injectivity
entities.description: 注入井的注入能力，受储层渗透率、表皮系数与破裂压力限制。

entities.name: Wellbore Thermal Stress
entities.description: 冷 CO2 注入引起井筒与近井地层热应力，可诱发裂缝。

entities.name: Wellbore Two-Phase Flow
entities.description: 井筒内 CO2 沿程相态变化导致的兩相流动与压力分布。

entities.name: Well Barrier Element
entities.description: 井屏障单元：套管、水泥环、封隔器、井口等各自独立的封隔件。

entities.name: Time-Lapse 4D Seismic
entities.description: 重复三维地震，通过差异成像追踪 CO2 羽流。

entities.name: Baseline 3D Seismic
entities.description: 注入前采集的三维地震，是 4D 差异的参照。

entities.name: InSAR Surface Deformation
entities.description: 合成孔径雷达干涉测量，监测注入引起的地表形变。
entities.reference: Vasco et al. (2010) Geophys. Res. Lett. 37

entities.name: Distributed Acoustic Sensing
entities.description: 光纤分布式声波传感（DAS），可沿全井段连续记录。
entities.reference: Daley et al. (2013) The Leading Edge 32

entities.name: Distributed Temperature Sensing
entities.description: 光纤分布式温度传感（DTS），用于识别注入层位与窜流。

entities.name: Downhole Pressure Gauge
entities.description: 井下压力计，是判断注入是否接近破裂压力的直接数据。
